title: 不定冠词(a/an)与定冠词the的基本用法
knowledgePoint: 不定冠词a/an的用法、定冠词the的基本用法、零冠词场景

questions.question: ______ university in our city has launched a new program to train ______ artificial intelligence specialists.
questions.explanation: 第一空university以辅音音素/juː/开头，需用不定冠词A（a用于辅音音素开头的单词前），表“一所大学”；第二空artificial intelligence specialists为复数名词表泛指，不用冠词，故答案为A; /。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 不定冠词a/an的核心区别：a用于辅音音素开头的单词前（a book, a European），an用于元音音素开头的单词前（an apple, an hour），需根据发音而非字母判断。

questions.question: The Earth revolves around the Sun, and the Moon revolves around the Earth.
questions.explanation: 世界上独一无二的事物（Earth, Sun, Moon, Sky, World等）前需加定冠词the，题干中三处the的用法均符合规则，表述正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 其他需加the的独一无二事物：the Pacific Ocean（太平洋）、the Himalayas（喜马拉雅山脉）、the Great Wall（长城）、the Universe（宇宙）。

questions.question: ______ most students in our class have ______ good command of English, which helps them communicate with foreign teachers smoothly.
questions.explanation: 第一空most students后有in our class限定，表“我们班的大多数学生”，为特指，需加the；第二空为固定搭配have a good command of（精通……），需用a，故答案为The; a。
questions.knowledgeExtension: most的用法：表“大多数”且无范围限定→零冠词（Most people like music）；表“某范围的大多数”且有定语限定→加the（Most of the students are here）。

questions.question: She plays piano very well and often performs at school concerts.
questions.explanation: 演奏乐器前需加定冠词the（play the piano/guitar/violin），题干中play piano缺少the，用法错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 球类、棋类运动前不加the（play football/basketball/chess）；乐器、西洋乐器前必须加the（play the erhu二胡，中国乐器前可加可不加，但习惯加the）。

questions.question: ______ old man I met yesterday told me that he used to be ______ teacher in a remote village.
questions.explanation: 第一空old man后有I met yesterday限定，表“我昨天遇到的那位老人”，为特指，需加the；第二空teacher以辅音音素开头，表“一名老师”，为泛指，需用a，故答案为The; a。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 特指的三种情况：1. 上文提到过的人/物（I saw a cat. The cat was black）；2. 有定语限定的人/物（the book on the desk）；3. 双方都知道的人/物（Pass me the pen）。

questions.question: English is widely used as an international language in business and education.
questions.explanation: 语言名称前通常不加冠词（English/Chinese/French），表泛指“英语”；an international language中an用于元音音素开头的单词前，用法正确，故题干正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 例外情况：当语言名称后有language修饰时，可加the（the English language）；某些特定语言相关表达加the（the Chinese=中国人，the English=英国人）。

questions.question: ______ useful advice our teacher gave us! It has helped us solve many practical problems.
questions.explanation: advice为不可数名词，不能用a/an修饰；此处为感叹句（What + 形容词 + 不可数名词 + 主语 + 谓语！），故答案为What。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 感叹句中a/an的用法：What a + 形容词 + 可数名词单数（What a beautiful flower!）；What + 形容词 + 可数名词复数/不可数名词（What beautiful flowers! What good news!）；How + 形容词/副词（How beautiful the flower is!）。

questions.question: We usually have breakfast at 7 o’clock in the morning and then go to school by bus.
questions.explanation: 三餐名称（breakfast/lunch/dinner）前通常不加冠词；by + 交通工具（by bus/by bike/by car）前也不加冠词，题干中两处零冠词用法均正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 三餐前加the的情况：有定语限定表特指（I had the breakfast you prepared for me）；表“某一顿具体的餐”（The dinner was delicious）。

questions.question: ______ number of visitors to the museum has increased by 30% compared with last year, which shows ______ growing interest in cultural heritage.
questions.explanation: 第一空为固定搭配the number of（……的数量），需加the；第二空growing interest以辅音音素开头，表“一种日益增长的兴趣”，为泛指，需用a，故答案为The; a。
questions.knowledgeExtension: a number of（许多）后接可数名词复数，作主语时谓语动词用复数，前不加the；the number of后接可数名词复数，作主语时谓语动词用单数，前必须加the。

questions.question: He is planning to study the economics at a famous university in the United States.
questions.explanation: 学科名称（economics/math/physics/history等）前通常不加冠词，题干中study the economics多了the，用法错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 学科名称前加the的情况：表“某一门具体的课程”（I am taking the economics course this semester）；与of连用表“……的学问”（the economics of education）。

questions.question: ______ elephant is ______ largest land animal on Earth, and it plays an important role in ______ ecosystem of Africa.
questions.explanation: 第一空elephant以元音音素/e/开头，表“一头大象”（泛指某类动物），需用An；第二空largest为形容词最高级，前必须加the；第三空ecosystem后有of Africa限定，表“非洲的生态系统”，为特指，需加the，故答案为An; the; the。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 形容词最高级、序数词前通常加the（the tallest building, the first day）；但序数词表“又一、再一”时不加the（a second chance再一次机会）。

questions.question: They visited the Great Wall, the Summer Palace and other famous scenic spots during their trip to Beijing.
questions.explanation: 由普通名词构成的专有名词（如the Great Wall, the Summer Palace, the United States, the People’s Republic of China）前需加the，题干中用法正确。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 无需加the的专有名词：人名（Tom, Li Ming）、地名（Beijing, Shanghai）、国名（China, Japan）、山脉名称（Mount Tai）、湖泊名称（West Lake）。

questions.question: I have ______ friend who works as ______ doctor in ______ hospital near my home. ______ doctor is very kind to patients.
questions.explanation: 第一、二、三空均为泛指（一位朋友、一名医生、一家医院），friend/doctor/hospital均以辅音音素开头，需用a；第四空doctor为上文提到过的人，为特指，需加The，故答案为a; a; a; The。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 第一次提到的人/物用不定冠词a/an（表泛指），再次提到时用定冠词the（表特指），这是the的核心用法之一。

questions.question: She goes to school by the bike every morning because it is convenient.
questions.explanation: by + 交通工具（bike/car/bus/train/plane等）前不加the，正确表达为by bike，题干中by the bike多了the，用法错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 如果交通工具前有定语修饰，需用介词on/in，且加the/a（如on a blue bike, in my car, on the bus I took yesterday）。

questions.question: ______ important thing we should remember is that ______ honesty is the best policy in interpersonal relationships.
questions.explanation: 第一空important以元音音素开头，表“一件重要的事”，需用An；第二空honesty为不可数名词（抽象概念），表泛指“诚实”，前不加冠词，故答案为An; /。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 抽象名词（honesty/kindness/love/truth等）表泛指时前不加冠词；表“某一种具体的品质/情况”时加a/an（a kindness一件善事，a great honesty一种非常诚实的品质）。

questions.question: The China is a great country with a long history and rich culture.
questions.explanation: 国名China为专有名词，前通常不加the，题干中The China多了the，用法错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 国名前加the的情况：由普通名词构成的国名（the United States, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands）；含复数形式的国名（the Philippines, the Maldives）。

questions.question: He spent ______ whole day reading ______ book about ______ history of ancient Rome.
questions.explanation: 第一空为固定搭配spend a whole day（花费一整天），用a；第二空book以辅音音素开头，表“一本书”，用a；第三空history后有of ancient Rome限定，表“古罗马的历史”，为特指，用the，故答案为a; a; the。
questions.knowledgeExtension: whole的用法：a whole + 名词单数（a whole week一整周），the whole + 名词复数/不可数名词（the whole class全班同学，the whole water所有的水）。

questions.question: We watched a interesting movie last night, and the movie told a story about environmental protection.
questions.explanation: interesting以元音音素/ɪ/开头，前需用不定冠词an，而非a，正确表达为an interesting movie，题干中a interesting movie用法错误。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 判断用a还是an，关键看单词的发音开头是否为元音音素，而非字母：an hour（/aʊ/元音音素）、a university（/juː/辅音音素）、an honest man（/ɒ/元音音素）。

questions.question: ______ President of the United States will visit our country next month, and ______ visit is expected to promote bilateral cooperation.
questions.explanation: 第一空President of the United States为独一无二的职位名称，前需加the；第二空visit为上文提到过的“访问”，为特指，需加the，故答案为The; the。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 独一无二的职位、头衔前通常加the（the President, the Prime Minister, the Queen）；但若作表语、同位语时不加the（He was elected president of the company）。

questions.question: She has a great interest in the literature and often reads works by famous writers.
questions.explanation: literature为不可数名词，表泛指“文学”时前不加the，题干中the literature多了the，用法错误；若表“某一特定的文学领域”（如the literature of the Tang Dynasty），可加the。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 类似的不可数名词（表泛指时零冠词）：science（科学）、art（艺术）、music（音乐）、history（历史）、nature（自然）。
